_comment: Per-country transmission voltage floor (kV) for metric I4, pinned 30 August 2026 per AMENDMENT_DRAFT_I4_transmission_thresholds.md. A line counts toward I4 when kv >= floor. Entries marked needs_pin are held out until a flag-officer decision; the derivation refuses to run for them.
_basis: measured line-km by voltage from each country's grid-geo.json; floor is the TSO transmission tier

uk._basis: The UK holds three transmission definitions. A single national floor is wrong in both directions: 132 counts 17,783 km of English and Welsh DISTRIBUTION as transmission, 275 drops 4,880 km of genuine Scottish and Northern Irish TRANSMISSION.

_needs_pin.greenland: 265 km total; 132 kV implausible for the system

_us_basis: NERC Bulk Electric System: Transmission Elements operated at 100 kV or higher. A cited standard, not our choice; and 100 vs 115 moves only 9,842 km (1%), so the pin is insensitive to it. Excludes 69 kV (360,666 km), which NERC excludes.
